summary: An endless row that scrolls on its own, for logos or tags, with a key that pauses it; it stands still when someone asks for reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: The items, such as logos or tags, repeated for as long as the row runs.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the row moves, in pixels per second.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stops the row while a pointer is over it or focus is inside it.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the pause key is pressed, with whether the row is now paused.

props.name: pauseButton
props.description: Shows a key at the row's end that pauses and resumes it. Turn it off only when the page has its own control, since moving content needs one.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the row out at both ends.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: What the row holds, read once by screen readers instead of the moving copy.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the pause key. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.ariaLabel: Opens Documents, Photos, Music, Spreadsheets, Notes, Archives, Code, Videos
